core_obligations: Uniqueness up to unique isomorphism is cited from the same-chapter uniqueness lemma; existence is proven by induction on the number n of opens in the cover (proof lines 11283-11340).

n=2: the gluing lemma produces K on U_1 cup U_2 with isomorphisms to K_{U_1} and K_{U_2} compatible with rho_{U_1,U_2}; for a general U in the basis the two candidate identifications over U cap U_1 and U cap U_2 agree by the compatibility property of rho_{U_1,U_2} (remark-uniqueness), and the uniqueness lemma yields the unique isomorphism K|_U -> K_U making (K, rho_U) a solution.

n>2: apply the induction hypothesis to X' = U_1 cup ... cup U_{n-1} with the induced basis, enlarge the system by the solution K_{X'} (condition (3) preserved for the enlarged system by the uniqueness lemma), and reduce to the case n=2 for the cover X = X' cup U_n.
proof_roadmap: Uniqueness cited; induction on the cover: n=2 glue and pin by uniqueness; n>2 merge the first n-1 opens and reduce.
difficulty_reason: Induction over a finite cover: the n=2 case glues via the gluing lemma and pins the isomorphism by uniqueness; n>2 merges the first n-1 opens by induction and reduces to n=2. H2: assembly with standard-input closes.
